about: Free Law Project judge-pics portraits for judge pages that show no portrait, bound by an exact identifier chain. Captured 2026-10-27 from read-only SELECTs on corpussite (judge_cl_crosswalk, cl_people, judges, judge_portraits_open, corpus_artifacts) and src/lib/judges/portraits.server.json; see database/contracts/judge-portraits-release-20261027.sql for the queries. Every release row's index slug must agree with the CourtListener name (index_name_consistent). Owner decision 2026-10-27: an unrecorded licence is a caution hold, not source evidence, so it is released with the licence shown as not recorded.

accounting.note: People: 1158 + 16 + 4 + 66 = 1244. already_shown counts people whose judge page shows a portrait from this collection (judges.photo_url or src/lib/judges/portraits.server.json), excluding person 153 (held: wrong portrait). The 66 without a judge page include persons 3 and 9084 (inaccurate index entries).

held.reason: Inaccurate index entry: judge-pics slug baker-josh (a Tennessee judiciary portrait) carries CourtListener person 153, which is John Harris Baker (1832-1915, D. Indiana; CourtListener records no photo). The portrait is not of him. It is currently served on judge page a541216ed0772341c8fc96bdbf85e527 through src/lib/judges/portraits.server.json and must be removed there (see the release notes).

Inaccurate index entries not shown anywhere: adams-elmer-1842-10-27 carries person 3 (Thomas Jefferson) and thurston-buckner carries person 9084 (Jennifer L. Thurston, whose only judge record is a compatible-name possible match). Their stored artifacts are not referenced by any judge page.
Accuracy rule: Greg Shaw has two Alabama judges records and the crosswalk tier is ambiguous.

Accuracy rule: the CourtListener person (Barbara Lagoa, Florida District Court of Appeal) records no FJC id, so there is no shared identifier with the federal judge profile; a cross-system name match is not used.
Not a portrait of one person: the index entry group-ohio-2015-06-19 is a group photograph with person id 0.
